comment: A lean wolf of the high ground of region one, which hunts the pasture and the low land in packs (D-1353). It has the basic attack alone, and fire bites it hard. The level and the experience follow D-977, and a win rolls the gold from the low gold to the high gold (D-1157). PR-30 tunes each number. Its name is a common noun, so a battle line writes it in lower case after the start (D-1358).
